newsitem.title: UK: Bradford wool unmoved, production at a standstill.
newsitem.headline: Bradford wool unmoved, production at a standstill.

text.p: Players in the Bradford wool market failed to find any inspiration ahead of the Christmas and New Year Holiday's but they keenly awaited a pick-up in orders in the first quarter of 1997.
"The UK wool textile industry is closed from a production point of view until early January," one close observer of the slow market said.
Minor currency movements failed to impact on the market.
But the source was quick to point out that currency moves could alter selling attitudes in the coming weeks.
"If any one currency talking point persists it is the effect of strengthening in sterling on export pricing and demand.
Looking towards 1997 the source said one helpful development for upside gains, breaking recent stolid conditions, could be the Australian credit facility to encourage exports of wool to China.
